minutes.headline: Assessors voted to accept the senior tax deferral rate change and the 41D cost-of-living exemption for Town Meeting; 17D/E/F unresolved.
minutes.summary: The Board of Assessors met in person at the Eagle House because Zoom failed. They heard the principal assessor's status report, signed invoices and motor vehicle excise commitments, and reviewed the overlay surplus. Most of the meeting went to drafting warrant articles for Town Meeting on senior exemptions (Clause 41D, the 41A deferral, and the unresolved Clause 17 series). They also discussed a proposed simplification of the assessors' web page.

what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors voted to accept the adjusted income and asset limits for the Clause 41D senior exemption warrant article, as amended at the meeting.
The board voted to accept a warrant article changing the Clause 41A property tax deferral, with interest accruing at a stated rate on deferred funds.
The Clause 17D/17E/17F senior and surviving spouse exemptions were left unresolved; the board will ask town counsel, through the town manager, about setting an asset level.
The board reviewed the overlay surplus as information only; the senior work-off liability is to be reported once applications close.
The meeting was held in person because Zoom failed, and the next meeting was set for September 18.

why_it_matters: Two of the votes are articles meant for Town Meeting, so residents who are seniors, or who care for one, may be asked to vote on exemption limits and the deferral interest rate.

Exemptions granted under these clauses are covered from the overlay, the reserve held against abatements, and the state reimburses the town only a small amount, so wider eligibility shifts cost onto the tax levy or the reserve.

Town counsel's answer, via the town manager, on setting an asset level for Clause 17D.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on both votes (41D limits and the 41A deferral rate cut from 8% to 6%), the two invoices, and who attended. Most of the figure differences are caption garbling. The one to check is the prior-commitment motor vehicle abatements: ours reads $4,690.02 and the official minutes print $4,006.92.
